en: I see. That's a fine profession.
I hope we meet again. Goodbye.
It must be hard for you too, Justin.
Handling money is important work.
Hello. I hope you can help me.
Actually, I don't know the first thing about
bank accounts. Could you explain them?
A customer opening his very first account!
I'm sorry.
This is my first time in a city...
I'm not used to civilized society.
Now then, shall I explain?
Yes, please do.
Hello. Good to see you.
We really do keep meeting, don't we?
Thank you. I'll be counting on you.
Sorry, I just stopped by today
to see how you were doing
Am I being a nuisance?
No, this is our first meeting.
And it seems I've got the wrong house.
I'm sorry. Excuse me.
, my master. Ah, my liege
I am your hands and feet. As you wish
Did I bump into something reading again?
I've got a bruise. ...Oh, well.
Your orders, please. Anything at all
I dreamed I fought people like a beast.
It might well have been real.
Whoa... Careful.
Walking while reading
is hardly wise, wouldn't you say?
Hm? ...Ahh, I'm so sorry.
This book is just so fascinating
Forgive me. Are you hurt?
I am fine, but
your other books appear to have fallen.
Oh, I didn't even notice
Sorry, and thank you.
I'm Ralph. You'll find me at the library.
Do watch where you walk.
Whoops! Pardon me...
I can't help reading as I walk,
so I don't notice what's around me.
Do you like books?
Do visit the library sometime.
I'll recommend some books to you.
And in the library, I never ever
note: cut before 'bump': #4128 and #4229 (slice 052, msg 165520) continue with lowercase 'bump into anything.'

en: bump into anything.
I know it better than my own house.
! Well, well!
Good day. How have you been lately?
Ah, you look well. That's what matters.
Do come to the library, too.
I'll give you first pick of the books.
Mind you, I'm not supposed to.
note: follows #152 '...' on the same line: '...Mind you, I'm not supposed to.'

en: Hey!
Excuse me
You dropped your wallet, did you not
Huh
Ahh, good heavens. My wallet
S-sorry, and thank you so much.
Walking about reading when it's this dark
is dangerous.
No, you're absolutely right
Sorry. You saved my wallet.
Reading as I walk is a habit of mine.
Oh, let me thank you properly.
Please, tell me your name.
I need no thanks.
Take care where you walk from now on.
Yes, I'll try my best.
Thank you very much.
note: also Anthony the jeweller thanking a customer (msg 185209).

en: ! Hello there.
Lovely moonlit night. Perfect for reading.
On a night like this, strolling in the breeze
with a favorite book is simply wonderful.
Terrible crimes are happening around here.
You'd do well not to walk about at night.
Huh? Is that so?
